input: Sew a patchwork quilt from old band T-shirts

gold.taskTitle: Sew a Patchwork Quilt from Band T-Shirts
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to create a patchwork quilt using old band T-shirts as the fabric source material.

questions.title: How many T-shirts do you have to work with?
questions.description: Understanding the quantity of shirts available determines the quilt size and layout planning.

questions.title: What finished size should the quilt be?
questions.description: Knowing the target dimensions (throw, twin, queen, etc.) shapes the entire cutting and layout plan.

questions.title: What is your current sewing skill level?
questions.description: Skill level determines how complex the block pattern should be and what guidance is needed.

questions.title: Do you own a sewing machine or will you sew by hand?
questions.description: The available tools directly affect technique recommendations and realistic time estimates.

questions.title: Should the quilt have a backing fabric or batting layer?
questions.description: Knowing whether this is a full three-layer quilt or a simpler top-only project defines the materials list.

questions.title: Will you add any non-T-shirt fabric between the patches?
questions.description: Some quilts use solid sashing fabric to frame each shirt graphic, which affects material shopping needs.

questions.title: What is your target deadline for finishing the quilt?
questions.description: A deadline helps break the project into realistic milestones and prioritize which steps to tackle first.
